acceptance_criteria.criterion: ProjectMetaSchema accepts objects with and without new cached fields
Project initialization writes project_name, repository_name, total_work_packages: 0, pending_work_packages: 0 into .meta.json
Creating a work package increments total_work_packages and pending_work_packages in .meta.json
Completing a work package decrements pending_work_packages in .meta.json
handleListProjects uses cached values when present, avoiding extra file reads
handleListProjects falls back to I/O enrichment for legacy meta files
API response shape unchanged — optimization is transparent

comments.note: gui/api.ts previously contained a 55-line duplicate of readProjectName that is now replaced by the shared utility. Future duplication risk eliminated.

The planFile parameter in LedgerStore.writeProjectMeta is accepted but not used in the body (plan_path derives from this.planPath). The parameter could be removed in a follow-up cleanup to avoid misleading callers.

initializeProject enrichment write is wrapped in best-effort try/catch. If enrichment fails silently, handleListProjects would fall back to I/O for that project indefinitely. A WARN log would help diagnose silent cache misses in production, but STDIO discipline rules prevent adding stdout logging in this layer.

summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified against source code and test suite.

AC-1: project-meta.ts:11-14 — all 4 new fields (total_work_packages, pending_work_packages, project_name, repository_name) are z.optional(). Schema accepts objects with and without them. Specific schema tests in meta-enrichment.test.ts.

AC-2: project-lifecycle.ts:483-493 — initializeProject reads plan_file via readProjectName, derives repository_name, then calls writeProjectMeta with all 4 cache fields. Wrapped in try/catch for best-effort. Test at meta-enrichment.test.ts:120 verifies total=0, pending=0 written.

AC-3: ledger-store.ts:185-187 — writeRootIndex passes validated.total_work_packages + pending_work_packages to writeProjectMeta on every call, including when ledger_create_work_package increments counters in root index. meta-enrichment.test.ts:175-180 directly verifies the sync.
AC-4: ledger-store.ts:242-244 — updateWorkPackageWithSync (used by pipeline complete flow) also passes WP counters to writeProjectMeta. Same mechanism and same test coverage as AC-3.

AC-5: gui/api.ts:194-207 — fast-path condition: `meta.total_work_packages !== undefined && meta.project_name !== undefined`. When both present, uses meta values directly, skipping rootIndex and plan-file reads. api.test.ts 'WP-006: uses cached enrichment values' test confirmed.

AC-6: gui/api.ts:208-224 — else branch reads rootIndex I/O + readProjectName for legacy meta files. api.test.ts 'WP-006: falls back to I/O enrichment for legacy meta without cache fields' test confirmed.

AC-7: api.test.ts 'WP-006: response shape includes all required fields' test verifies slug, plan_path, status, date_created, last_updated, total_work_packages, pending_work_packages, project_name, repository_name are all present regardless of code path.
AC-8: 39 test files, 1167 tests, zero failures. TypeScript compiles clean (per implementation notes).

comments.note: AC-3 and AC-4 (counter increment/decrement in .meta.json) rely on the writeRootIndex meta-sync mechanism rather than direct WP create/complete flow tests. meta-enrichment.test.ts:175 verifies `writeRootIndex({total_work_packages:3,pending_work_packages:2})` propagates to meta, which is the same code path used by ledger_create_work_package and ledger_complete_pipeline. This is sufficient but indirect. A future improvement could add two integration-style tests: one that calls createWorkPackage via _internal and checks meta, and one that calls completePipeline and checks meta decrement.

initializeProject enrichment is wrapped in a silent try/catch (best-effort). If enrichment fails, the cache miss is not surfaced to any observable signal — no log, no field in the initialization response. STDIO discipline prevents adding logging in this layer. Consider adding enrichment_cached: boolean to the initializeProject response in a future WP, so callers can detect enrichment misses without logs.

The fast-path cache hit signal checks `meta.total_work_packages !== undefined && meta.project_name !== undefined`. The `total_work_packages` check is necessary because a project with 0 WPs needs to be a cache hit too (0 !== undefined). Correct — Zod schema has it as `optional()` so newly created projects with 0 WPs still have the field populated, not just omitted.

summary: Code review PASS. WP-006 meta enrichment cache implementation is architecturally sound, backward-compatible, and well-tested.
Schema changes: 4 optional fields added to ProjectMetaSchema with correct Zod types. All fields are optional, preserving full backward compatibility with existing .meta.json files.

Cache fast-path condition (`meta.total_work_packages !== undefined && meta.project_name !== undefined`) correctly distinguishes cache-populated (value or null) from legacy/absent (undefined). The nullable().optional() schema allows null as a distinct valid state for project_name.

Counter sync path is correct: both writeRootIndex and updateWorkPackageWithSync pass WP counters to writeProjectMeta on every root index write, ensuring meta stays in sync with the ledger state that triggered the update.

handleListProjects fast/fallback paths produce identical ProjectSummary shapes. meta.title still takes precedence over cached project_name in both paths — title override logic is correctly applied after the cache/fallback branch.
Extraction of readProjectName to src/utils/read-project-name.ts eliminates ~55 lines of duplication from gui/api.ts. Clean and well-scoped refactor.

11 new tests in meta-enrichment.test.ts + 5 new tests in api.test.ts. Coverage includes schema validation, initializeProject enrichment, writeRootIndex counter sync, cache fast-path, I/O fallback, and response shape invariant.

Medium-priority improvement flagged: enrichment failure in initializeProject is silently discarded by try/catch. STDIO discipline prevents a log warning here, but future diagnosability would benefit from a structured error event mechanism.

comments.note: Cache hit condition `meta.total_work_packages !== undefined && meta.project_name !== undefined` correctly distinguishes cache-populated (set to value or null) from legacy/absent (undefined). Zod schema correctly uses .nullable().optional() to allow project_name: null as a distinct valid state from absent. Semantics are precise.

repository_name is re-derived from projectRoot path at runtime in both fast-path and fallback, not read from meta.repository_name cache. This is correct — the field is deterministic from path and avoids staleness if the project is moved. The stored meta.repository_name field exists for MCP tool use but is intentionally not consumed in the GUI list path.

initializeProject enrichment wrapped in best-effort try/catch: enrichment failure silently leaves meta.total_work_packages undefined, causing handleListProjects to fall back to I/O for that project indefinitely. STDIO discipline prevents adding a WARN log in this layer. Consider a structured error event or debug flag in a future hardening pass so silent cache misses are diagnosable.

~55 lines of duplicate readProjectName logic removed from gui/api.ts and extracted to src/utils/read-project-name.ts. Clean refactor that eliminates a future drift risk between GUI and tool implementations.
